urgency_prototypes.highest: Critical urgency: immediate action required to prevent or fix a regulatory breach, security compromise, or major outage. No workaround.
urgency_prototypes.high: High urgency: rapid resolution needed within hours to avoid escalation. A workaround exists but is difficult or time-consuming.
urgency_prototypes.medium: Medium urgency: important to fix soon, with no immediate operational or regulatory threat. An easy workaround is available.
urgency_prototypes.low: Low urgency: handled in the normal workflow without urgent escalation.
urgency_prototypes.lowest: Lowest urgency: routine or informational request with no effect on operations or compliance.
